text: BAM share rose 0.07 percentage points over 21 hours and 0.22 percentage points over 7 days, to 34.5%. The latest leadership move put ams-mainnet-bam-1-tee at 21.7% of BAM stake, with 70 top-node changes in the window, consistent with whale-driven routing rather than a structural rollover. Concentration remains elevated: the node Nakamoto coefficient is 3.
